meta.description: Calls parents T-24h and T-2h before a Discovery call. Smallest.ai is already in the stack. Every attempt is a row in outreach_calls.

parameters.query:
with due as (
  select l.id as lead_id, l.parent_name, e.occurred_at as set_at,
    case
      when e.occurred_at - interval '24 hours' <= now()
       and e.occurred_at - interval '23 hours' > now() then 'discovery_t24'
      when e.occurred_at - interval '2 hours' <= now()
       and e.occurred_at - interval '1 hour' > now() then 'discovery_t2'
    end as purpose
  from lead_stage_events e
  join leads l on l.id = e.lead_id
  where e.stage = 'discovery_set'
    and not exists (
      select 1 from lead_stage_events d
      where d.lead_id = e.lead_id and d.stage = 'discovery_done'
    )
)
select * from due where purpose is not null
  and not exists (
    select 1 from outreach_calls o
    where o.lead_id = due.lead_id and o.purpose = due.purpose
  );

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Due T-24 or T-2').item.json.lead_id, $('Due T-24 or T-2').item.json.purpose] }}
